title: docs(agents): os-dev states nothing a seat starts wakes it, and ships the draft PR before verification ends
body:
Fixes #17044

## What changed

`.claude/agents/os-dev.md` only. 403/403 lines before and after (ratchet ceiling 403, headroom 0), widest line 120 bytes before and after, whole file 47,689 B → 47,732 B, 5 insertions / 5 deletions — paid in place, no ceiling raise, no re-wrap. The branch was merged with `origin/main` (`c43bac704`, which does not touch this file) before the PR was opened; the merged tree still measures 403 lines.

### What the contract already said on `origin/main` `854639b3`, and the gap

The card says the contract never states that a subagent cannot be woken by its own background job. Literally that is not quite so — the fact appears twice — but every placement is somewhere other than where the seat decides how to run a long verification, and none states it as a property of the host:

| line | sentence (verbatim) | how it reads |
|:--|:--|:--|
| :94, rule 6 (pipeline) | `⛔ 永不把验证挂在后台 watcher 上然后停轮;禁令与两种合法终态见干净收尾节。` | a prohibition plus a pointer: no fact, and no next step the seat can finish |
| :97, rule 7 (queueing) | `持锁的是你不拥有的进程,它的完成不会唤醒你。` | the fact, attached to the lock holder — a process the seat does not own — so the seat's own job reads as the opposite case |
| :308 / :310 (definition of done) | `PR 开出后 ⛔ 永不 sleep、定时等待或空转轮询 CI` · `永不用后台 watcher` | prohibitions about CI after the PR exists — read at the end, about a different object |
| :345, clean-finish rule 4 | `⛔ 永不结束回合去等 Monitor / 后台通知:结束回合即停摆,通知只送达在跑的回合。` | the fact, as the reason clause of a prohibition, in the section read while composing the report — after the backgrounding decision was made |

Five measured stalls in one day (table below), one of them with the prohibition verbatim in its dispatch, show that none of these placements was read as a general fact about this host.

### The edit, before → after

Rule 6 (资源纪律 — the rule read at the moment the seat decides how to run build and test) now carries the two sentences the ruling asked for:

- :94 before (109 B): `⛔ 永不把验证挂在后台 watcher 上然后停轮;禁令与两种合法终态见干净收尾节。`
- :94 after (119 B), sentence (a) — the host fact, stated as a fact and not as a prohibition: `宿主事实:你启动的后台作业、watcher、你请求的通知都不会唤醒你;结束一轮就是结束。`
- :95 new (112 B), sentence (b), first half: `有可展示内容即 commit、push 并开 draft PR,不等验证结束;验证结果到达即补进正文。`
- :96 new (117 B), sentence (b), second half: `带具名缺口的 PR 是交付进行中的常态,未读到的判决写 NOT MEASURED: FAMILY, reason: …` — the file spells the placeholder in angle brackets; it is written as FAMILY here because GitHub mutates body bytes.

Two in-place rewrites keep existing lines consistent with (a) and (b); neither adds a line:

- :97 → :99 (112 B → 115 B): `它的完成不会唤醒你` → `其完成同样不会唤醒你`. The lock holder's completion is now an instance of the host fact stated three lines above, not a property of the lock.
- :307 → :309 (115 B → 109 B): `报告在 draft PR 时点交付,CI 收敛等待归 PM 不归你:分支一推上、PR 一开出,立刻交报告。` → `报告在本地验证走完时交付,CI 收敛等待归 PM 不归你:⛔ 不为等 CI 结论推迟报告。` Under (b) the draft PR exists before verification ends, so a report anchored to "PR opened" would read as "report before running anything" — the reading the ruling forbids. The line's intent (CI convergence is the PM's wait, never the dev's) is unchanged; only the anchor moves. This is a consistency rewrite of an existing rule, not a third new sentence; if the PM prefers the original wording it reverts in isolation.

Two deletions pay for the two new lines. Both are strict restatements of clean-finish rule 4's own head line (`⛔ 永不以等待 / 监视姿态结束一轮:一轮只在报告交付时结束,而报告只有两种。`):

- :343 (100 B): `⛔ 不以结束一轮当反轮询解法:停轮不是合规替代,它恰是本条禁止的终点。`
- :345 (110 B): `⛔ 永不结束回合去等 Monitor / 后台通知:结束回合即停摆,通知只送达在跑的回合。` — its fact clause is now rule 6's sentence (a), stated once, where it is needed.

Kept unchanged in rule 4: :341 (the supported foreground idiom, `tail --pid`), :342 (report-time `NOT MEASURED` with reason), :346 (the pre-end self-check), :347 (keep the turn alive and collect the exit codes yourself).

`grep -n "唤醒" .claude/agents/os-dev.md` — before: 97, 330, 343 · after: 94, 99, 332, 346 (:94 is sentence (a); :99 is the rewritten rule 7; the other two are clean-finish lines, unchanged).

### Why rule 6 and not the clean-finish section (PM mechanism assumption 1)

Confirmed from the file's own structure rather than from reading order, which the file cannot measure: rule 6 is the only rule that says how build and test are run (`整条流水线在前台跑`), so it is the rule a seat consults when it is about to start a long verification; the clean-finish section is consulted when the report is being composed, by which time the backgrounding decision — and the stall — has already happened. In this run the author read rule 6 before running any gate and the clean-finish section only when writing the report; that is one trace consistent with the assumption, not a measurement of other seats.

### Why a fact plus a default path, not a stronger prohibition

Instance 3 stalled after receiving the prohibition as a message; instance 5 stalled with the prohibition and the escape hatch verbatim in its dispatch. A prohibition removes the only terminating action the seat can see and gives it nothing to finish; an escape hatch phrased as a fallback clause is read as an exception. Sentence (a) removes the belief that waiting can work; sentence (b) makes the shippable state continuously reachable, so the wait branch has nothing to offer. Instance 5 also showed the escape hatch is unreachable when nothing has been committed — (b) starts at commit and push, which closes that gap.

## Evidence: five stalls, four seats, one lane, one day

From the card's fifth-instance comment (5596487585); each was recovered only because the PM noticed the completion event and intervened by hand:

| # | card | seat | had the rule in its dispatch? | recoverable by "open the PR"? |
|--:|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| 1 | #16896 | A | no | yes |
| 2 | #16679 | B | no | yes |
| 3 | #16679 | B | yes (as a message) | yes |
| 4 | #16828 | C | no | yes |
| 5 | #17062 | D | yes (in the dispatch) | no — nothing committed |

The seats' own last words, verbatim: "I'll stop here and wait for the Monitor's completion notification", "I'll resume analysis and proceed to open the PR once these finish and report back", "I'll stop polling now and wait for the background watcher's completion notification", "I'll wait for the gate batch to complete before continuing — the monitor will notify me when it's done." Every path each seat could see ended in "wait".

Whether other lanes' seats stall the same way is the card's sweep question and is not claimed here; the numbers above are this lane's own.

## What this PR does not change

- The acceptance contract: the deliverable is still draft PR + report comment + final report JSON; the report's `gates` field keeps its meaning; `in_progress` and `NOT MEASURED` with a reason remain the honest values. No gate requirement is relaxed: (b) says the PR exists before verification ends and the results are appended — not that verification is optional.
- `references/dispatch-runbook.md` (241/241): untouched. Its 停摆复位梯度 section already carries the posture sentence and ends with 「生产侧条款在 os-dev 定义」 — the production-side clause is exactly this PR. The PM's dispatch practice (direction 3 on the card) is not a file change.
- No product semantics, no published package, no spec. `skip-changeset` applies: `.claude/**` ships in no package's `files[]`.

## Delivered in the shape sentence (b) prescribes? (PM mechanism assumption 4)

Half yes, half no — reported as it happened. The edit was committed (`f30cd5d38`) and pushed before any gate was run, and `origin/main` was merged and pushed (`5ace0eab9`) before any gate was run — the commit-and-push half. The open-the-draft-PR half was attempted in the same turn as the first gate batch, but the create call failed on a shell-quoting slip in the body composition (an apostrophe inside a single-quoted `node -e` string), and the two gate batches launched in parallel returned before the retry. So this PR was opened one turn later than (b) prescribes, after 16 of 17 verdicts were already read, and the 17th (a prerequisite build plus a re-run) was finished while the body was being written. The sentence held on the half that mattered in instance 5 — the branch carried the committed work from the start — and the PR-open half slipped on tooling, not on a decision to wait.

## Verification

Governed-surface predicate, pasted verbatim (`node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --test .claude/agents/os-dev.md`, exit 3):

```text
governed-surface predicate: 1 of 1 path(s) hit the register (5 surfaces, repo-agnostic).
  ⛔  GOVERNED — a human merge is the review record for this PR (#9495 regime).
      No seat flips it ready, enqueues it, or arms auto-merge (AGENTS.md Prime Directive #14).
      One hit governs the whole PR — 「混合 diff 一条命中即整 PR 分叉」; proportion is not a question.
      .claude/** ×1 — the agent instruction tree (skills, agents, hooks, settings)
        - .claude/agents/os-dev.md
```

Gate list derived with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` (no paths passed; change set read from the merge base): 17 commands — 10 matched by path, 7 whole-tree. The derivation also names `scripts/check-partof-closing-keyword.mjs` as taking a value from the workflow (`PR_COMMITS_FILE`), so its real mode is CI-measured; only its `--self-test` — which pins the citation at :281 of this file, untouched — runs locally.

## 验收备注

- noted, not filed: the definition-of-done heading still reads 按序 and lists push and draft PR after tests; with (b) the PR exists earlier. The list remains the order in which items must hold at report time, so no heading change was made. 承接者:无.
- noted, not filed: after :345's deletion the capitalised word `Monitor` (the harness tool the stalled seats named) no longer appears in the file; sentence (a) covers it as 你请求的通知 and clean-finish rule 1 still names 后台 monitor. 承接者:无.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么**:只改开发 agent 的工作契约 `.claude/agents/os-dev.md`,行数 403 → 403,不抬上限。在「整条流水线在前台跑」那条规则下加了两句:① 宿主事实——你自己启动的后台作业、watcher、请求的通知都不会唤醒你,结束一轮就是结束;② 默认路径——有可展示内容就 commit、push 并开 draft PR,不等验证结束,验证结果到达再补进正文,带具名缺口的 PR 是交付进行中的常态。为付行数,删掉收尾节里两条对同一禁令的复述,并把两处既有句原地改一致(锁的完成「同样」不唤醒你;报告改在本地验证走完时交,而不是「PR 一开出立刻交」)。

**为什么改**:一天内五次开发 agent 停摆(四个席位、同一车道),每次都是把长验证挂到后台然后结束回合等通知——而这个宿主根本不会送通知。契约里原本有这个事实,但挂在「锁」的段落里,读起来像锁的性质;第三、第五次证明单靠禁令和兜底子句都拦不住,只有把「等待」这条路改成不存在:先有 PR,验证结果后补。每次停摆都占住并发 3 里的一个槽位,直到有人手工发现。

**风险与代价(含回滚)**:不改验收标准、不放松任何门禁、不涉及产品语义;风险是措辞被误读成「开了 PR 就可以不跑验证」——正文与报告口径已明确「PR 先于验证结束,结果后补」。回滚 = revert 本 PR 的单个提交,无其它依赖。

**席位意见**:(留空)

**你要做的**:确认这两句的措辞与落点,人工合并(受管面,不入队、不挂 auto-merge)。
